basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent enthusiast in woodworking, trying to learn the ropes while juggling a part-time job at a local coffee shop in Great Falls. Originally from De Anza, I've always loved crafting things with my hands. In my free time, you'll find me exploring new woodworking techniques or catching a game of baseball. I'm passionate about social justice and frequently engage in discussions around men's rights. Currently single, I enjoy spending my evenings browsing Reddit and watching Monster Rancher reruns.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm relatively new to woodworking, having picked up the hobby about a year ago after attending a local workshop in Great Falls. I've been self-teaching through online resources, forums, and YouTube videos. My background in customer service has taught me the importance of patience and attention to detail, which I apply in my woodworking projects.
